tools.name: search_signals
tools.description: Search the scored RWA / tokenization / family-office signal feed. All filters are optional and combine with AND. Returns signals with intent score (0–100), tier, region, entity, summary and source URL, plus total_matching.

tools.name: get_signal_brief
tools.description: One signal in full: the factor-by-factor score breakdown, fit rationale, entity and source URL. Pass the `id` from search_signals.
